hooks.command: if [ ! -f package.json ]; then exit 0; fi; npm run lint 2>&1 && npm run build 2>&1 && npm run test 2>&1

INPUT=$(cat); COMMAND=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf|git\s+push\s+--force|git\s+reset\s+--hard|DROP\s+TABLE'; then echo "BLOCKED: 위험한 명령어가 감지되었습니다: $COMMAND" >&2; exit 2; fi
